speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Wash at the door. I have had the kettle, and I am not starting thee a second one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can wash in what is left. I am not a guest.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thou art a man who has not yet been as far as the bench. The bread is after that, as I said. I have not changed it.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Susanna has asked twice whether the book may come down. I told her the shelf, until thou hast been out and back. Do not make me a third time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The shelf can hold. I am going out. I will look, and I will come back fit to be fed.
